proof: If $d=\mathrm{intdeg}(\mathcal H)$, monomials supported on at most $d$ of the $n$ coordinates span every function on $\mathcal H$.  Since the function space has dimension $|\mathcal H|$, we have $|\mathcal H|\le\sum_{i=0}^{d}\binom ni\le(n+1)^d$.  Hence $d\ge\log(|\mathcal H|)/\log(n+1)$, up to the Log Size Ratio normalization.
name: Interpolation degree / Log Size Ratio
witness_verification: For #classes/full_cube with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $\frac{\log(2^n-1)}{\log(n+1)}$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
